_comment: Runs of the conformance suite (spec/IR_SPEC.md section 11.4): one results file per engine, with every case's verdict and detail. SKIP means the engine has no path for the case (the reference: the gradient cases, which are its own finite differences; mtstudio: single ops other than expr and recurrence, sessions, document loading, refusals, dequantisation; ember: single ops other than recurrence, whose run_node its adapter has, and the gradient cases, since it does not train). All three runs are of keramos v1.1.2 (284 cases).

runs.engine: numpy reference (tools/ir_numpy.py) (numpy 2.3.3, Python 3.12.3, WSL ext4), against keramos v1.1.2 (33dff0348d4e2e1035acbbc933f1e7bb61f87ff1)

paperkiln mtstudio, CPU, with ir_eval (recurrence nodes, their gradients, the digest) and expr_eval (ext4 clean clone, Release, GCC 13.3, vendored transformer_core, -ffp-contract=off), against keramos v1.1.2 (33dff0348d4e2e1035acbbc933f1e7bb61f87ff1)

ember.cpp ir_adapter, CPU interpreter, ember 39dcce94886fbac759c26c123007d7e106b84aed (/home/jonat/ember_adapter_39dcce9/build/ir_adapter (git archive of that commit, CPU only: HAS_CUDA off, Release, GCC 13.3, WSL ext4; the interpreter's IR translation units with -ffp-contract=off); hello: 'ir_adapter 2 (IR versions 0 and 1; spec revision 1.1)'), against keramos v1.1.2 (33dff0348d4e2e1035acbbc933f1e7bb61f87ff1)
